items.problem: CastingDevicePicker (and DevicePicker) require InitializeWithWindow.Initialize before .Show() on WinUI 3 desktop, but the picker section never names them.
items.evidence: Scenario2_CastingDevicePicker.xaml.cs lines 24-26 add WinRT.Interop.InitializeWithWindow.Initialize(picker, hwnd) for a CastingDevicePicker before picker.Show(...) (line 62). session-log line 2718 records 'CastingDevicePicker -> InitializeWithWindow'.
items.covered_at: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md 'Pickers and Win32 Surfaces' (anchor #pickers, lines 266-279) — documents the InitializeWithWindow pattern and lists FileOpenPicker/FileSavePicker/FolderPicker, DataTransferManager, PrintManager, then says 'and other UI surfaces that target a window'.
items.proposed_improvement: Add CastingDevicePicker and DevicePicker to the explicit InitializeWithWindow surfaces list so the Show(rect,...) device/casting pickers are named alongside the file pickers, rather than left to the vague 'other UI surfaces' catch-all.
items.generalizes: Any UWP app doing device/media casting or Bluetooth/Wi-Fi device selection uses CastingDevicePicker/DevicePicker; all need the same HWND init on WinUI 3 desktop or they throw COMException at runtime (invisible to the build).
